in_marathi.name: Devdan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devdan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devdan is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'God's gift' or 'Heavenly gift'. In Hindu mythology, Devdan is believed to be a name given to those blessed by the gods.
